feedback: The illustration perfectly captures Mary Magdalene tearfully clutching a spice jar on a cold, pre-dawn path surrounded by olive trees, exactly matching the text's solemn and sorrowful tone.
The illustration beautifully portrays Mary Magdalene's frozen, shocked expression with hands clasped to her chest in front of the rolled-away tomb stone, matching the story's emotional intensity.
The illustration perfectly captures Mary Magdalene weeping at the tomb's entrance while two luminous angels in pure white sit where Jesus' body had lain, matching the text seamlessly.
The illustration effectively depicts Mary weeping outside the tomb while Jesus watches her with quiet compassion.
The illustration captures the garden setting and the emotional dialogue between a tearful Mary and a gentle Jesus well.

The illustration perfectly captures the tender moment of recognition from the text, beautifully showing Jesus speaking warmly while Mary reacts with stunned awe and tears of relief amidst the golden morning light.
The illustration accurately captures the radiant, blooming garden setting along with Mary's astonished, tearful adoration of the risen Jesus.
The illustration beautifully captures Mary Magdalene kneeling in joyful reverence before the risen Jesus in a sunlit garden, perfectly matching the emotions and narrative of the text.
The illustration matches the garden setting, reverent tone, and characters' actions depicting Jesus commissioning Mary.
The illustration beautifully captures Mary running joyfully along the sunlit hillside path with triumphant hope, perfectly matching the spirit and opening action of the text.
